aboutText: Based on Grange Road in Alphington, Pickards Automotive provides specialist British and European car servicing across Fairfield, Thornbury and Northcote. Our team is dedicated to precise vehicle servicing that keeps you reliably on the road. From advanced diagnostics to routine logbook servicing, we treat every vehicle with the care it deserves. We pride ourselves on outstanding customer service, budget-friendly pricing, and making car maintenance simple and transparent.
servicesText: From complex diagnostics to routine maintenance, Pickards Automotive covers all your British and European vehicle needs in Alphington and the inner north.

reviews.text: Pickards Automotive in Alphington looked after my BMW 3 Series with a full logbook service. The team was upfront about costs and had it ready the same day. Really glad I found a reliable European car specialist so close to home.
reviews.name: James Mitchell

reviews.text: Our cafe van kept stalling and no one could figure out why. The guys at Pickards ran a full diagnostic and found a wiring fault within a couple of hours. Honest pricing and brilliant service — highly recommend them to anyone in the inner north.
reviews.name: Sarah Coleman

reviews.text: I manage a small fleet of Land Rovers and Pickards Automotive handles all our servicing from their Alphington workshop. Their brake service and mechanical repairs are always thorough, and the pickup and drop service saves us so much time. Wouldn't go anywhere else.
reviews.name: David Nguyen
